description: [``botocore``] This release introduces the AWS Abuse Signal API, enabling customers to programmatically submit and track AWS abuse reports.

[``botocore``] Adds s3BucketMount to mount an Amazon S3 bucket as a file system in AgentCore Runtime, with an optional per-session key prefix and adds operatingSystemConfiguration with a Linux privilegeMode (STANDARD or PRIVILEGED) to the capacity provider configuration
[``botocore``] Supporting a new PAUSED device status and a DeviceStatusReason.
[``botocore``] Adds support for populating intermediate tables with results from PySpark analysis templates.

[``botocore``] AWS CloudFormation StackSets now provides stage-by-stage progress for deployments that span thousands of accounts and AWS Regions, which enables you to see where each deployment stands while it runs
[``botocore``] Add support for restoring user pool's user data to point in time.

[``botocore``] This release adds support for the keyExchange field in CloudTrail tlsDetails, enabling customers to distinguish classical from post-quantum hybrid key exchange for TLS connections on Application Load Balancers.
[``botocore``] Update endpoint-rules client to latest version
[``botocore``] Adds resource tags functionality to the AWS Health service

[``botocore``] Adds MaxSignInSessionDuration to IAM Roles and Login Profiles, allowing customers to configure the maximum Console sign-in session duration per principal. Affects CreateRole, UpdateRole, GetRole and LoginProfile APIs.
[``botocore``] Neptune Database Serverless support for graviton3 based r8g instances.
[``botocore``] This release includes support for adding new field for the effective policy used in test runs and documentation updates.

[``botocore``] Adds exclusions and Multi-Region key resolution to S3 Replication. Rule filters support a Not element to exclude prefixes and object tags. Destination EncryptionConfiguration supports UseSourceMultiRegionKey to encrypt replicas with the related replica KMS multi-Region key in the destination Region.
[``botocore``] This release adds support for resuming a paused penetration test job from its last saved checkpoint.
[``botocore``] This release adds support for Spillover Routing in Amazon SES.

[``botocore``] These APIs enable customers and administrators to list, view, and revoke AWS Sign-In Sessions programmatically using the AWS CLI and SDKs, providing greater visibility and control over authenticated access.
[``botocore``] Updated endpoint resolution for AWS Support, including FIPS and dual-stack endpoints.

[``botocore``] Adds the AnalyticsConfig parameter to CreateWebACL and UpdateWebACL to enable or disable cross-Region security analytics for a WebACL. When you enable security analytics, you authorize AWS to transfer and store full request logs outside the AWS Region where the WebACL is hosted.
[``botocore``] Cache static User-Agent components to reduce per-request CPU overhead without changing the emitted header.
